description: This file defines the UploadedFileFactory class, which implements the creation of UploadedFile instances using provided parameters and adheres to the UploadedFileFactoryInterface, serving as a factory for uploaded file objects in the Laminas Diactoros HTTP message implementation.

classes.name: UploadedFileFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating UploadedFile instances, implementing the UploadedFileFactoryInterface.

methods.name: createUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an UploadedFile instance from a stream and optional metadata such as size, error status, filename, and media type.
